primary_endpoint: Change from baseline in Matsuda Index and Adipo-IR Index at Weeks 12 and 24.
efficacy_outcome: No significant differences versus placebo on either primary endpoint: Matsuda Index p=0.2483 and p=0.053; Adipo-IR Index p=0.5297 and p=0.2522.
safety_signal: Serious adverse events occurred in 0/20 cenicriviroc recipients and 1/25 placebo recipients; no deaths.
